# incusos_system_update (Resource)

Manages IncusOS system update policy (`/1.0/system/update`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `channel` (String) Update channel (e.g., `stable`, `testing`).
- `check_frequency` (String) Update check frequency as a Go duration (e.g., `6h`) or `never`.

### Optional

- `auto_reboot` (Boolean) Automatically reboot when an OS update requires a reboot.
- `maintenance_windows` (Attributes List) Optional maintenance windows during which updates may be checked and applied. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--maintenance_windows))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `needs_reboot` (Boolean) Whether the host requires a reboot to apply a pending OS update.
- `status` (String) Current update daemon status.

<a id="nestedatt--maintenance_windows"></a>
### Nested Schema for `maintenance_windows`

Required:

- `end_hour` (Number) End hour (0-23).
- `end_minute` (Number) End minute (0-59).
- `start_hour` (Number) Start hour (0-23).
- `start_minute` (Number) Start minute (0-59).

Optional:

- `end_day_of_week` (String) End day of week (`Sunday`..`Saturday`). Must be set together with `start_day_of_week`.
- `start_day_of_week` (String) Start day of week (`Sunday`..`Saturday`). Must be set together with `end_day_of_week`.
